Hi Nicholas,

Yes, that works. We can put the value of the replacement Hammer BC04 toward a Thor P2 and you pay the difference. The T. P2 lists at $379 today and the BC04 replacement is $249, so the gap is around $130. A colleague is picking this up today and will send you the invoice for the exact amount, so nothing to pay until you see it.

Two things to know. The T. P2 is not in stock today, it is a pre-order that ships by November 3, 2026. And nothing goes out until your faulty NerdQX is back with us, so please write Shop···· clearly on the outside of the box when you send it with the prepaid label.

Your BC04 replacement stays held in your name in the meantime, so you lose nothing if you change your mind.

Sorry again for how long the NerdQX fault dragged on, and thanks for your patience with it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
